# Yuru Camp△ Mapa (ゆるキャン△ 聖地巡礼)

> Free fan app and web map (es/en/ja/zh/ko/fr/ar) of the real places from the anime Yuru Camp△ / Laid-Back Camp: the 21 real campsites from seasons 1–3 and the movie, plus 451 anime locations with their frame. Made by Tony Hanma, a guide in Japan.

- App (web, Android, iOS): https://2troll.github.io/yurucamp-mapa/
- Guide in Spanish: https://2troll.github.io/yurucamp-mapa/guia/
- Guide in English: https://2troll.github.io/yurucamp-mapa/guia/en.html
- Features: interactive map, episode guide, GPS pilgrim mode that alerts you at a real scene, camera with the anime frame overlaid to recreate it, shared photo wall (anime vs real), Japanese camping vocabulary and quizzes, campsite weather and Mt. Fuji visibility.
- Contact (Tony Hanma, guide in Japan — Spanish, English, Arabic): WhatsApp https://wa.me/34634193106 · https://tonykansaiguide.com/
- Unofficial fan project. Yuru Camp△ © Afro / Houbunsha.

## Campsites
- 1. Kōan (浩庵キャンプ場) — T1 · ep. 1 — Campsites on the shore of Lake Motosu, with the same view of Mt. Fuji as the 1,000-yen bill. In winter, it drops below 0 °C at night. [35.4732, 138.5748]
- 2. Fumotoppara (ふもとっぱら) — T1 · ep. 3 & 11-12 — A huge meadow with Mt. Fuji right in front. It gets very windy: stake down your tent well. [35.3994, 138.5643]
- 3. Eastwood (イーストウッドキャンプ場) — T1 · ep. 4-5 — Forest campground in Yamanashi. Firewood is sold at reception. [35.7112, 138.6595]
- 4. Meseta de Takabotchi (高ボッチ高原) — T1 · ep. 5 — You can see Lake Suwa and Mt. Fuji; at dawn there is often a sea of clouds. The road is usually closed in winter: check beforehand. [36.1352, 138.0370]
- 5. Lago Shibire (四尾連湖 水明荘) — T1 · ep. 6-7 — Small lake hidden between mountains, with the legend of a ghost. The car stays in the parking lot. [35.5306, 138.5187]
- 6. Monte Jinbagata (陣馬形山キャンプ場) — T1 · ep. 9-10 — Free mountaintop campsite overlooking the Ina Valley. Reached via a narrow mountain road. [35.6730, 137.9832]
- 7. Ryūyō Kaiyō Kōen (竜洋海洋公園) — T2 · ep. 2 — Auto campground next to the Pacific in Iwata. [34.6522, 137.8070]
- 8. Nagisa-en (lago Hamana) (渚園キャンプ場) — T2 · ep. 3 — On the shore of Lake Hamana, near the large torii gate of Bentenjima. [34.6989, 137.6061]
- 9. Cabo Ōmama (lago Yamanaka) (大間々岬) — T2 · ep. 5-6 — Mt. Fuji on the other side of Lake Yamanaka, one of the coldest lakes in the area during winter. [35.4237, 138.8929]
- 10. Parque Nodayama (野田山健康緑地公園) — T2 · ep. 7-8 — Fujikawa municipal park with a covered cooking area (炊事場). [35.1483, 138.5978]
- 11. Hosono Kōgen (細野高原ツリーハウス村) — T2 · ep. 10 — Higashi-Izu Plateau, famous in autumn for its susuki (silver grass) fields. [34.7943, 139.0164]
- 12. Camp Koganezaki (キャンプ黄金崎) — T2 · ep. 11 — In western Izu; the Koganezaki cliff turns golden at sunset (hence its name). [34.8427, 138.7656]
- 13. Darumayama Kōgen (だるま山高原キャンプ場) — T2 · ep. 12 — View of Mt. Fuji over Suruga Bay. [34.9744, 138.8544]
- 14. Shōji Lakeside (精進レークサイドキャンプ場) — T3 · ep. 1 — Lake Shōji is the smallest of the Fuji Five Lakes. [35.4934, 138.6073]
- 15. Apt Ichishiro (アプトいちしろキャンプ場) — T3 · ep. 3-5 — Next to the Ōigawa railway, where the train climbs using a rack system (Apt system, アプト式). [35.1668, 138.1496]
- 16. Mizugakiyama (みずがき山自然公園) — T3 · ep. 7-8 — Beneath the granite rocks of Mt. Mizugaki, one of Japan's 100 famous mountains. [35.8957, 138.5730]
- 17. Garganta Ōyanagawa (大柳川渓流キャンプ場) — T3 · ep. 9 — Fujikawa Gorge with waterfalls and suspension bridges. [35.5045, 138.3990]
- 18. Río Sanogawa (佐野川河川公園) — T3 · ep. 10 — Riverside in Nanbu, Nadeshiko's hometown. [35.2516, 138.5037]
- 19. Kawaguchiko Tozawa (夢見る河口湖 コテージ戸沢センター) — Movie (2022) — Cabins and campsite by Lake Kawaguchi. [35.5227, 138.7539]
- 20. Minobu Shizen no Sato (みのぶ自然の里) — Movie (2022) — Mountain campground in Minobu. [35.4719, 138.4033]
- 21. Ashiyasu (芦安キャンプサイト) — Movie (2022) — Mountain campsite in Minami-Alps, gateway to the Southern Alps. [35.6316, 138.3616]
